summary: The biggest gap is systematic failure of sub-agents to execute the mandatory Step 4 post-write validation (phase3-detail.md), resulting in 36 missing 数据流 sections across 4 of 9 modules (50/124 complete blocks = 40%). This single failure cascades into R5, P3, S3, S5, and S6 failures. Secondary issue is YAML front matter field name drift in 8/9 sub-agent outputs (using 'title' instead of 'module_name', etc.) despite the correct template being available in SKILL.md. All failures are agent_error root causes — the Skill documentation is correct but lacks enforcement mechanisms. Priority fix: add a blocking, machine-verifiable section count gate before submit_analysis in the sub-agent prompt.
